items.title: 駭客利用大數據平臺Qubole被竊憑證，入侵數十家企業AWS環境竊取資料
items.summary: 雲端資安業者Sentra與Wiz於11月9日揭露一起供應鏈攻擊事件，駭客取得大數據處理與資料湖平臺Qubole的AWS身分與存取管理（IAM）憑證，利用企業先前授予Qubole的跨帳戶存取權限，入侵數十家企業的AWS環境。

items.title: 主動管理AI價值與風險，Gartner建議企業可採取三項措施
items.summary: 在10月下半於美國佛州舉行的Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo大會上，IT 研究與顧問公司Gartner探討資訊長現在面臨的一項關鍵挑戰：如何讓價值累積的速度超越風險成長的速度。

items.title: CISA警告6個弱點遭積極利用，其中包含Outlook、Chrome零時差漏洞
items.summary: 11月10日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）宣布，已掌握6個新漏洞遭到積極利用的證據，將其列入已知遭利用漏洞名單（KEV），並要求聯邦機構限期修補。

items.title: Apple發布iOS、iPadOS 27.2.1與18.7.12版，緊急修補10個資安漏洞
items.summary: Apple於11月9日發布iOS與iPadOS 27.2.1版及18.7.12版安全更新，兩份公告分別列出9個與6個CVE漏洞編號，扣除重複項目後，共修補10個獨立漏洞，受影響功能主要集中在iMessage、AirPlay及Bluetooth等三方面。

items.title: 微軟警告Outlook零時差漏洞已遭到利用
items.summary: 微軟於11月例行更新（Patch Tuesday）共修補超過1千個資安漏洞，其中有一個特別值得注意，原因是該公司已偵測到漏洞利用活動，呼籲用戶儘速安裝修補程式。

items.title: SAP發布11月例行更新，修補4個滿分漏洞
items.summary: 企業應用軟體公司SAP於11月10日發布本月例行更新（Security Patch Day），修補旗下多項企業軟體產品的安全漏洞。本次公布35個應用系統的資安漏洞、4個在GitHub公布的程式庫弱點，並更新先前發布的3份資安公告內容。其中最受關注的地方，在於本次修補4個CVSS嚴重程度評分達10分的重大漏洞，分別影響SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP、SAP Web Dispatcher，以及SAP Gateway等應用系統。

items.title: fix(skills): report unsupported YAML keys without a traceback (#197131)
items.summary: fix(skills): report unsupported YAML keys without a traceback (#197131) fix(skills): report non-text SKILL.md frontmatter keys without a traceback When SKILL.md frontmatter had an unsupported top-level key that YAML reads as a number, boolean, null or date, such as true: x or 2026-11-11: y, the bundled skill validator sorted and joined the keys directly and crashed with a TypeError traceback, and package_skill.py crashed with it. The keys are now converted to text before they are listed, so the existing "Unexpected key(s) in SKILL.md frontmatter" message is shown. Evidence: both shipped scripts in python:3.11 with no network and PyYAML installed. On main, 1:, true:, null: and 2026-11-11: keys and a mix with text keys each exit 1 with a traceback. With this change each exits 1 with the existing message, and package_skill.py prints its existing validation failure line. An unsupported text key, a valid skill (byte-identical package) and an existing .skill file kept on failure behave the same on both. Net 0 test lines. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197131#issuecomment-6791219704. Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(agents): keep session forks on the parent's cached prompt prefix …
items.summary: fix(agents): keep session forks on the parent's cached prompt prefix (#197074) * fix(agents): keep session forks on the parent's cached prompt prefix Advisor reviews and /btw side questions fork the live session, but their Anthropic requests never reused the parent's cached messages: - the fork sent raw transcript tool-call IDs, while every foreground request sends them through the attempt's ID normalizer, so the prefix diverged at the first tool call; - the fork forced tool_choice none, and Anthropic invalidates every cached message block when tool_choice changes. Apply the attempt's own ID normalizer to live fork messages, and keep the parent's Anthropic tool_choice unless the request carries a hosted server tool, which runs before the fork can deny it. Client tool calls are still denied by the existing loop. scripts/perf/advisor-fork-prefix-gateway.ts records the main and fork request bodies from an isolated Gateway with a loopback Anthropic model. Co-authored-by: obviyus * fix(agents): normalize only fork tool-call IDs before pending-call pairing The live fork reused the attempt's full replay normalizer, which also repairs tool-use pairing. On Anthropic that synthesized an "interrupted" error result for a tool still running in the parent, before the fork could add its non-error "still running" placeholder, so a reviewer saw a false failure. Expose an ID-only variant of the same normalizer for forks. Extend the live Anthropic fork integration case to a parent tool that is still running, keep the client-tool tool_choice assertion on the parent's value, and document the conditional Anthropic tool choice. Co-authored-by: obviyus * test(agents): keep fork test lines within the ratchet Co-authored-by: obviyus --------- Co-authored-by: obviyus

items.summary: fix: honor explicit beta plugin authentication deferrals (#197112) * fix: honor explicit beta plugin authentication deferrals Bind operator-reviewed package failures to the live approved parent receipt. Hosted exact-head proof required before landing.
